description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeWorkShiftAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It includes unit tests for fetching, validating, deleting, and updating employee work shift data through the API, using mocks and assertions to verify behavior.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkShiftAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeWorkShiftAPI endpoints and behaviors within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a specific employee's work shift, mocking dependencies and verifying the normalized result and meta information.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the API's validation rules for fetching a single employee work shift.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the delete operation raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks validation rules for the delete operation, expecting a not implemented response.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests that the update method is not implemented and raises appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the update operation, expecting a not implemented exception.
